summary: Backend testing of new offline-scheduled selfie feature. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_offline_selfie_sync.py (16 tests, all PASSING) covering POST /api/mobile/selfie-sync (missed, idempotency, verified match at similarity>=0.93, mismatch/no_face), session-flag propagation, GET /api/mobile/reconcile selfie_config+schedule payload, admin endpoints under /api/offline-selfies (list, status filters incl. 'flagged' aggregate, /{id}/photo 200 for captured & 404 for missed, /{id}/review), role isolation (employee 403 on all three admin routes), and regression of the online challenge-respond flow. Face-match uses Obama vs Biden real face images (~face_recognition sample set) — verified obama-vs-obama returns similarity >= 0.93 and biden-vs-obama-baseline returns mismatch/no_face and flags the active session.

minor.issue: Response items do NOT include the mobile-side 'client_selfie_id' field (only server-side 'id'). Admin console cannot correlate a row back to a mobile draft, and clients that want to reconcile locally-known selfie IDs must re-send them through /selfie-sync (which returns duplicate:true) instead of just reading the list. See /app/backend/routes/gaps.py list_offline_selfies() ~line 158-177 — add 'client_selfie_id': s.get('client_selfie_id') to the projection.

action_items: (minor) Include 'client_selfie_id' in GET /api/offline-selfies list response so admin UI / mobile clients can correlate rows with local drafts.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/mobile.py selfie_sync(): the DuplicateKeyError branch (line ~1161) still appends to `results` but does NOT `continue` past the security-event / session-flag block correctly — actually it does 'continue' before those blocks, good. Verified idempotency test: same client_selfie_id twice → single Mongo row.

routes/mobile.py selfie_sync(): 'no_baseline' status is recorded but does NOT log a security event or flag the session. This is arguably correct (employee hasn't enrolled) but may hide silent misconfigurations — consider a low-severity security_event so admins notice unenrolled employees getting scheduled selfies.
routes/gaps.py list_offline_selfies(): O(N) per-row user lookup — for N=200 offline selfies this is 200 Mongo round-trips. Batch with a single $in query (same pattern as sessions/live).

Mobile draft face_photo Pydantic max_length=6_000_000 with a payload cap of 50 drafts per sync = up to 300MB request body theoretically accepted. Consider an aggregate cap or streaming/multipart upload to prevent OOM on a burst reconnect.
offline_selfies unique index on (user_id, client_selfie_id) is scoped to user_id but NOT org_id — if a user ever migrates between orgs (edge case) IDs could collide silently. Low priority.
test_credentials: Present in /app/memory/test_credentials.md — owner akmaljn7@gmail.com / GeofenceAdmin123!, employee employee@example.com / Employee123! (both used).
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates a temporary TEST_OfflineSelfie_* office per module and cleans it up; the employee face baseline is enrolled/reset per test via /api/face/enroll and /api/face/reset; all offline_selfies rows created by the tests are wiped from Mongo in the autouse fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the suite serially: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_offline_selfie_sync.py -v -o 'addopts='` (the project pytest.ini defaults to pytest-xdist parallel which corrupts the single-employee-account test fixtures — do NOT run in parallel unless each test uses an isolated employee). All 16 tests pass end-to-end in ~20s. The only outstanding minor is that GET /api/offline-selfies doesn't project client_selfie_id — main agent should add it and re-run this same file.
rca of the issue: During first run, 6/16 tests failed. Root causes: (a) pytest.ini enables pytest-xdist parallel workers — two workers logged in as the SAME single seeded employee, colliding on active_sessions and offline_selfies rows; running with '-o addopts=' to disable xdist resolved 2 failures (session-flag test + online regression test). (b) The remaining 4 failures were a real API defect: GET /api/offline-selfies does not return client_selfie_id, so my tests couldn't correlate DB rows. Fixed by looking up the id via a direct Mongo helper in the test, and reported the API gap as a minor action item for the main agent.
